body:
Please provide an MRP to make this easier to test and fix:
- A small Godot project which reproduces the issue, with no unnecessary files included. Be sure to not include the `.godot` folder in the archive (but keep `project.godot`).
- Having an MRP is very important for contributors to be able to reproduce the bug in the same way that you are experiencing it. When testing a potential fix for the issue, contributors will use the MRP to validate that the fix is working as intended.
- Drag and drop a ZIP archive to upload it (max 10 MB). **Do not select another field until the project is done uploading.**
- **Note for C# users:** If your issue is *not* C#-specific, please upload a minimal reproduction project written in GDScript. This will make it easier for contributors to reproduce the issue locally as not everyone has a .NET setup available.

Also did you use AI to write this issue report? Please be aware that we require issue reports to be human written

I can reproduce this issue as well.

Godot 4.7.2 stable, Web export using the Compatibility renderer (WebGL 2.0), Android/Chrome.

My case is very similar: a 3D character using Skeleton3D + MeshInstance3D disappears, while the scene and nodes remain present and there are no useful rendering errors.

I isolated the problem further:

- MeshInstance3D without Skeleton3D → renders normally.
- AnimationPlayer without Skeleton3D → renders normally.
- Skeleton3D + skinned MeshInstance3D → character can disappear.
- The problem can persist/reappear after reloads.
- The same character can render correctly in some runs and become invisible in others.

This strongly suggests that the problem is related to the WebGL/Compatibility skinning path rather than the character asset or AnimationPlayer itself.

Additional reproduction information:

My main test device is a Samsung Galaxy A35 5G using:

- Godot 4.7.1.stable.official (a13da4feb)
- Compatibility renderer / WebGL2
- OpenGL ES 3.2
- ARM Mali-G68
- Kiwi Browser 139.0.7339.0

I found a very specific sequence that reproduces the issue repeatedly:

1. Open the Web export.
2. Open Chrome/Chromium DevTools.
3. Go to the Performance panel.
4. Start recording.
5. Stop recording.
6. Click the Reload button inside the Performance panel.
7. After the reload, the character/skinned mesh disappears.

I repeated this sequence multiple times and was able to reproduce the problem consistently on the A35.

I also tested another Godot 3D Web game to check whether the problem was specific to my project or assets:

https://dangermomentum.itch.io/1256-sim

I was able to reproduce a similar rendering problem there using the same testing procedure. This suggests that the issue may not be specific to my project or imported character asset.

I also tested other Android devices, including a Samsung Galaxy A22. On those devices the problem appeared to be intermittent rather than consistently reproducible.

The A35 + Mali-G68 + Kiwi Browser combination gives me the most reliable reproduction so far.

Please investigate the Skeleton3D/skinned mesh rendering path on Web/Android, especially the GLES3/WebGL2 skin/bone buffer or texture handling across WebGL context/reload states.

It would be great to have a fix or workaround in the engine, since animated 3D characters are expected to work normally in Web exports.

I hope this additional reproduction information helps narrow down the cause.
Please open a new issue this has been closed
